recentItems.title: Police, protesters clash outside Durban Home Affairs Refugee Centre - Taliesha Naidoo updates
recentItems.description:

recentItems.title: Reserve Bank assessment points to a substantial increase in generalised price hikes in SA
recentItems.description:
The threat of more generalised price increases in the local economy has increased substantially. This was the word from the Reserve Bank, which convened its Monetary Policy Review meeting, reflecting on monetary policy from April to September 2026. 

The Monetary Policy Committee of the SARB raised rates by 50 basis points during the period as it sought to deal with evidence of higher inflation and influence price expectations. 

Nompumelelo Siziba filed this report.

For more news, visit sabcnews.com and #SABCNews on all Social Media platforms.

recentItems.title: Police deployed as tensions mount outside Durban Refugee Centre
recentItems.description:
Tensions remain high in Durban outside the Home Affairs Refugee Reception Centre.

Operations were disrupted yesterday by activists from the anti-migrant group March and March. 

The confrontation involved activists, law enforcement and foreign nationals seeking documentation.

SABC News reporter Taliesha Naidoo is monitoring the situation and joins us live now.

recentItems.title: [GRAPHIC CONTENT] Family pleads for justice after Mahikeng woman’s death
recentItems.description:
Please note the following story contains graphic content. The family of 30-year-old Omphemetse "Mimi" Moleleki of Seweding Village near Mahikeng in the North West is calling for justice following her death. 

Moleleki was allegedly attacked and raped on Saturday night, before succumbing to her injuries in hospital on Sunday. 

No arrests have been made, while police investigations into the circumstances surrounding her death are continuing. 

SABC News Reporter Tebogo Phakedi and Video Journalist Tumelo Setlhabetsi visited the family. 

For more news, visit sabcnews.com and #SABCNews on all Social Media platforms.

recentItems.title: Brown Mogotsi case postponed to 23rd October 2026
recentItems.description:
The case of self-proclaimed political fixer Brown Mogotsi has been postponed to the 23rd of October 2026 for the defence to argue its application to compel the State to provide further particulars. 

Mogotsi faces charges including unlawful possession of a firearm, perjury and defeating the ends of justice, linked to an alleged staged assassination attempt in Vosloorus last year (2025).

recentItems.title: Ramaphosa officiates CSIR FuturePharma Facility launch - 07 October 2026
recentItems.description:
President Cyril Ramaphosa will officiate the launch of the CSIR FuturePharma Facility. 

The facility aims to advance pharmaceutical innovation and manufacturing. 

The launch takes place at the CSIR in Pretoria and marks an important milestone in efforts to strengthen South Africa's pharmaceutical innovation ecosystem and expand domestic capacity to develop and manufacture critical medicines and products.
